rec.name: Cart "Good Choice" Reassurance Banner
rec.status: Built — delivered, reviewed internally (product image requested and supplied)

what.text: A slim, full-width banner at the top of the cart drawer, directly under the drawer header. It shows a check-mark icon and a short reassurance message, e.g. "Good choice! Your order will be in your hands within 1-2 business days." Background color, text color, icon, icon size, message text and font sizes (desktop and mobile) are all editable in the theme editor. It is built as a block with a limit of 1 inside the mini-cart (cart drawer) section.

why.text: Right after add-to-cart, buyers often feel post-decision doubt. Positive reinforcement ("good choice") validates the decision, and the delivery promise removes uncertainty about shipping time. A soft green background with a check mark signals success and safety. Placing it at the top of the cart keeps it visible at the moment of commitment and can reduce cart abandonment. The message text can also be swapped for brand or ingredient value messaging, as the second screenshot's example copy suggests.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet `ed-cart-good-choice.liquid`. It renders a flex container with an icon (inline SVG takes priority over an uploaded image), plus a richtext content area. CSS variables for text color, background, icon size and font sizes are set via a style tag scoped to the section ID. A `no-icon` class makes the text full width when no icon is set. On mobile (<1000px), the icon takes about 16% of the width and the text about 74%. 2) In `mini-cart.liquid`, add a `good_choice` block to the schema (limit 1) with the settings listed below. 3) In `mini-cart.liquid`, find `drawer__header` and directly below it loop over `section.blocks`, rendering the snippet for blocks of type `good_choice`. The merchant then adds the block to the Cart drawer in the theme editor and fills in the color, icon and text.

items: Icon as image (image picker, 20x20 SVG recommended)
Icon as SVG (HTML field; overrides the image)
Content (richtext, default: bold "Gute Wahl!" plus delivery sentence)

dependencies.text: Theme with a `mini-cart.liquid` cart drawer section containing a `drawer__header` element, and a `--container-gutter` CSS variable. No metafields and no app are needed. The ticket's acceptance criteria also mention the cart page, and rounded vs. square corners plus left vs. centered text alignment as settings. The delivered code only covers the cart drawer, with fixed text-align center and no corner-radius setting. The default text color `rgba(0,0,0,0)` is fully transparent and should be overridden when the block is added. The ticket flags the 1-2 business day claim as an example; it must match the real shipping promise.

items: Support tickets or questions about delivery time
